test_name: AppService > authorization and cart/order behavior > supports supplier product CRUD and stock adjustments
normalized_error:
expect(received).toBe(expected) // Object.is equality
Expected: false
Received: true
suspected_root_cause: Initial triage misdiagnosed this as an app bug in supplierProducts() (app.service.ts:323) missing an isActive filter. Deeper investigation showed the frontend supplier dashboard (supplier.tsx:349) has a 'Hidden' tab that depends on supplierProducts() including inactive/soft-deleted products so suppliers can review and reactivate them via setSupplierProductActive(). Customer-facing listProducts() (app.service.ts:68) and product() (line 69) already correctly filter isActive, so there is no customer-facing leak. The real defect was the test's assertion, which expected hard-delete-style exclusion instead of the intended soft-delete (isActive:false, still listed) behavior.
fix: Updated the test assertion (app.service.spec.ts:333-337) to check that the removed product remains in supplierProducts() with isActive:false, instead of expecting it to be absent from the list. No application code changed — soft-delete + Hidden-tab behavior preserved as designed.
